description: Maps external railway tags to internal dataset concepts. Primarily maps OSM railway tag values to registry dataset identifiers. Does not modify OSM collectors — only defines mapping relationships.

mappings.description: OSM railway=station maps to the station_master dataset.
OSM railway=halt maps to the station_master dataset (halts are minor stations).
OSM railway=stop maps to the station_master dataset.
OSM railway=junction maps to the station_master dataset.
OSM railway=terminal maps to the station_master dataset.
OSM railway=rail represents track geometry. Not mapped to the 7 registered datasets at this stage.
OSM railway=platform represents platform geometry. Not mapped to the 7 registered datasets at this stage.
OSM railway=signal represents signal nodes. Not mapped to the 7 registered datasets at this stage.

notes: Tag mapping registry. Maps external tag values (primarily OSM railway tags) to internal dataset IDs. Null dataset_id means the tag is recognized but not mapped to a registered dataset at this stage. No URLs, API endpoints, or download logic are included. Does not modify OSM collectors.
